bio: Sean is a data engineer by day; movie guzzler, spreadsheet hound, and singer/actor by night. Since he was a child with pen and paper in hand, he has long had a passion for listmaking, ranking things he loves, and coming up with predictive formulas. On occasion he can be seen performing musical theater and improv comedy on stages in the Dallas/Fort Worth metroplex. He is also the vice president of Inside Thoughts Productions, a production company that focuses on highlighting local talent in every artform. He joined the Fantasy Filmball server just before fall festival season in 2025, and has been thrilled to be a part of a robust, intelligent community of individuals who share his passion for cinema and statistics. Follow him on Awards Expert: @seanywack. Follow ITP on Instagram: @inside.thoughts.productions
name: Sean Malloy
